```yaml
name: Docker Smoke Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  docker-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: docker build -t arr-dashboard:latest .

      - name: Run container
        run: docker run -d --name arr-dashboard -p 3000:3000 arr-dashboard:latest

      - name: Wait for service to become healthy
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health | grep -q "ok"; then
              echo "Service is up"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for service..."
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Run smoke tests
        run: |
          # Basic health checks
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/health
          curl -f http://localhost:3000/api/health
          # Add any additional smoke test commands here

      - name: Show container logs on failure
        if: failure()
        run: docker logs arr-dashboard

      - name: Stop and remove container
        run: docker rm -f arr-dashboard
```
